title: TGD001 Treatment in Thrombotic Microangiopathies
official: An Adaptive Dose Escalation and Expansion Basket Trial to Explore the Safety, Pharmacology, and Clinical Activity of TGD001 in Immune-Mediated Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (iTTP) and Other Thrombotic Microangiopathies
summary: Main objective: To assess the safety and tolerability of TGD001 in participants with suspicion or clinical diagnosis of an acute iTTP episode
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult: age ≥18 at the time of signing the informed consent form (ICF)
2. Willing and able to provide informed consent and sign the ICF
3. Male or female of childbearing potential must refrain from sexual intercourse or must use a contraceptive method that is highly effective (with a failure rate of <1% per year) during the trial and for at least 90 days after the last dose of trial drug
4. Symptomatic acute TMA episode
5. Patient accessible to follow-up
Exclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis other than TMA, which could account for the findings of thrombocytopenia and hemolytic anemia (e.g., disseminated intravascular coagulation [DIC], Evans syndrome)
2. Pre-existing severe medical, neurological, or psychiatric disease that would significantly confound the endpoint evaluations (Investigator judgment)
3. Known hypersensitivity to any of the trial treatments or their excipients or to drugs of similar chemical classes
4. Participant participating in a trial involving an investigational drug or device within the last 30 days that would impact this trial
5. Participants who cannot comply with trial protocol requirements and procedures
6. Severe active infection indicated by sepsis (requirement for pressors with or without positive blood cultures)
7. Pregnant or breastfeeding
8. History of bleeding diathesis or evidence of active abnormal bleeding within the previous 30 days
9. Active internal bleeding
10. Indication of symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage (sICH)
11. Severe, uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure >180 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure >110 mmHg)
12. Disseminated malignancy or other co-morbid illness limiting life expectancy <3 months independent of the TMA disorder
13. Recent major surgery (Investigator judgment)
